definitions: A software application or online tool designed to help users manage and follow the progress of their fantasy sports teams, often providing real-time updates, statistics, and scores.
A feature within a fantasy sports platform that allows participants to monitor live game action, player performance, and scoring changes relevant to their fantasy roster.
examples: I rely on the Fantasy GameTracker to see how my players are doing.
The app's Fantasy GameTracker updated every minute.
Many users find the Fantasy GameTracker essential during Sunday games.
